H01.name: slip_wet
H01.title: Slip & Wet Floor
H01.description: Liquid spills, damp or polished floor surfaces, soap residue, or loose mats creating loss of traction on walking paths.

H02.name: trip_clutter
H02.title: Trip & Walkway Clutter
H02.description: Objects, trailing cables, clutter in primary walking paths, or uneven floor transitions that can cause stumbles.

H03.name: electrical
H03.title: Electrical Hazard
H03.description: Exposed electrical wiring, damaged insulation, overloaded power strips, sockets near moisture, or uncovered wall outlets.

H04.name: fire_heat
H04.title: Fire & Heat Hazard
H04.description: Open flames, hot stovetops or cookware, space heaters, hot liquids, combustible materials near heat sources, or gas cylinder issues.

H05.name: sharp_glass
H05.title: Sharp Objects & Glass
H05.description: Unsheathed knives, broken glass or ceramics, razor blades, sharp metal edges, or uncovered cutting tools.

H06.name: fall_height
H06.title: Fall from Height
H06.description: Unguarded stairs, open balcony or window ledges, ladders, raised platforms, open drains, or steep drops without barriers.

H07.name: unstable_falling
H07.title: Unstable & Falling Objects
H07.description: Tall unanchored furniture, televisions on unstable or narrow stands, heavy items stacked on high shelves, or insecure hanging fixtures.

H08.name: chemical_poison
H08.title: Chemical & Poison Hazard
H08.description: Household cleaning chemicals, unsealed medicines, pesticides, detergents, alcohol, or corrosive fluids accessible within reach.

H09.name: choking_small_objects
H09.title: Choking & Small Objects
H09.description: Loose coins, button batteries, small toy parts, beads, small magnetic items, or pebbles that pose choking hazards for young children.

H10.name: water_drowning
H10.title: Water & Drowning Hazard
H10.description: Open buckets or tubs filled with water, uncovered storage tanks, filled bathtubs, paddling pools, or open drainage sumps.

H11.name: strangulation_entrapment
H11.title: Strangulation & Entrapment
H11.description: Dangling blind or curtain cords, loose ropes, plastic bags, cords near cribs, or entrapment gaps in railings and furniture.

H12.name: structural_damage
H12.title: Structural Damage
H12.description: Cracks in walls or ceilings, spalling or hanging plaster, severe damp or mould patches, broken railing, or loose architectural elements.

H13.name: poor_visibility
H13.title: Poor Visibility & Glare
H13.description: Inadequate illumination on stairs or hallways, blinding glare, shadows obscuring hazards, or obstructed lines of sight.

H14.name: outdoor_traffic_terrain
H14.title: Outdoor Traffic & Terrain
H14.description: Vehicle traffic proximity, open gates near roadway, potholes, broken sidewalks, steep slippery slopes, or exposed utility wiring outdoors.

H15.name: other_observable
H15.title: Other Observable Hazard
H15.description: Physical hazards directly visible in the scene that do not clearly fit into categories H01 through H14; classified with uncertain status.

low.label: Low
low.description: Minor physical injury unlikely or easily avoided.

high.label: High
high.description: Substantial risk of severe injury requiring urgent mitigation.

uncertain.label: Uncertain
uncertain.description: Potential hazard requiring visual confirmation or closer inspection.

outcomes.none_observed: No hazards observed in this view
